### Creating Balanced Training Data

```{r}
# start and end time are in seconds

trainingdata = add_observations(whaledf = data,
                                start_time = 0,
                                end_time = 200,
                                num_time_steps=20, 
                                numcep = 12,
                                step_size = 0.05)

table(trainingdata$Humpback)

numnegatives = nrow(trainingdata %>% filter(Humpback == 0))


# taking row numbers of positive observations

trainingpositives = trainingdata %>% filter(Humpback == 1)


sort(sample(c(1:nrow(trainingpositives)), size = numnegatives))

trainingpositives[sample(c(1:nrow(trainingpositives)), size = numnegatives),]


trainingdatabalanced = rbind(trainingdata %>% filter(Humpback == 0),
                              trainingpositives[sample(c(1:nrow(trainingpositives)), size = numnegatives),]
                                  )

table(trainingdatabalanced$Humpback)
```


## Not Saving Predictions


```{r}
rf_tuning_cv_multi_nopreds <- function(mtry_values = floor(sqrt(ncol(trainingdata) - 3)), 
                                       trees_values = 500, 
                                       min_n_values = 50) {
  tic("My Function Timer")
  
  training_cvs <- vfold_cv(trainingdata, v = 5)
  
  # custom metric set
  my_metrics <- metric_set(
    precision,
    recall,
    f_meas
  )
  
  # model
  rfmod <- rand_forest(
    mtry = tune(),
    trees = tune(),
    min_n = tune()
  ) %>%
    set_engine("ranger") %>%
    set_mode("classification")
  
  # recipe
  rfrecipe <- recipe(Humpback ~ ., data = trainingdata) %>%
    step_rm(Time_Start, Time_End) %>%
    step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors()) %>%
    step_dummy(all_factor_predictors())
  
  # workflow
  rfworkflow <- workflow() %>%
    add_model(rfmod) %>%
    add_recipe(rfrecipe)
  
  # grid
  rf_grid <- expand_grid(
    mtry = mtry_values,
    trees = trees_values,
    min_n = min_n_values
  )
  
  # tune
  rf_tuned <- rfworkflow %>%
    tune_grid(
      resamples = training_cvs,
      grid = rf_grid,
      metrics = my_metrics,
      control = control_grid(save_pred = FALSE)
    )
  
  # collect metrics
  metrics_f1 <- collect_metrics(rf_tuned)
  
  toc()
  
  return(list(
    mtry_values = mtry_values,
    trees_values = trees_values,
    min_n_values = min_n_values,
    tuning_results = rf_tuned,
    metrics_f1 = metrics_f1
  ))
}
```


```{r}



results2 <- rf_tuning_cv_multi_nopreds(mtry_values = floor(sqrt(ncol(trainingdata)) - 3),
                                       trees_values = c(500,1000),
                                       min_n_values = 50)

metric_set = results2$metrics_f1 %>% select(mtry, trees, min_n, .metric, mean) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = .metric,
    values_from = mean) %>% select(mtry, trees, min_n, recall, precision, f_meas) %>%
  rename(F1 = f_meas)# precision, recall, F1


metric_set %>% # F2 scores
  mutate(
    F2 = ifelse(
    is.na(precision) | is.na(recall) | (recall + 4*precision) == 0,
    NA_real_,
    (5 * precision * recall)/(recall + 4*precision)
    )
    )

```




## Creating Output for Raven Visualization

```{r}

raven_output = function(testingoutput, start, end){

  rftestingoutput = rfwindowpredictions %>% 
    dplyr::select(Time_Start, Time_End, Humpback, prediction)
  
  
  #creating dummy low and high frequencies
  
  rftestingoutput = rftestingoutput %>% mutate(low = rep(0, times = nrow(rftestingoutput)),
                           high = rep(2000, times = nrow(rftestingoutput)))
  
  
  rftestingoutput = rftestingoutput %>% filter(prediction == 1) %>% 
    rename("Begin Time (s)" = Time_Start, "End Time (s)" = Time_End, 
           "Low Freq (Hz)" = low, "High Freq (Hz)" = high) %>% 
    dplyr::select(c("Begin Time (s)", "End Time (s)", 
                    "Low Freq (Hz)", "High Freq (Hz)"))
  
  
  #create output 
  write.table(rftestingoutput, paste0("rfevalwindowpreds", start, end, ".txt"), 
              sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
}

raven_output(testingoutput = rftestingoutput,
             start = min(rfwindowpredictions$Time_Start),
             end = max(rfwindowpredictions$Time_End))

```
